nodes.title: LOCKED PHOTO DETAIL + REALISM RECIPE
widgets_values:
# FLUX.2 Klein 9B – Upgrade Photo Detail & Realism v1.1

This v1.1 interface runs the exact proven Upgrade generation engine. The version change removes the inconsistent public v1 label; it does not change sampling, references, prompt construction, or postprocessing. For the included source, the engine selects the exact prompt embedded in the approved PNG and rebuilds the same guide pixels.

1. Load the exact photo to improve.
2. When changing the photo, replace the included source-specific pose, gaze, clothing, and material description in `detail_instructions`. Changed text selects the generic four-role prompt; generic preserve-everything wording was not enough for the included example.
3. Choose `Attractiveness`: `off` skips all face/hair/iris polish; `low` (default) preserves the previous handsome v4 treatment and source-gaze lock; `high` adds stronger brow definition, bounded source-guided upper-lid curvature, clearer iris/sclera contrast, reduced under-eye shadow, and crease attenuation. High runs after gaze lock, keeps eye corners and pupil position fixed, never copies source pixels, and leaves the background exact. It remains optional: on the canyon test, six-reference identity was 0.7461 Low versus 0.7247 High. Review the visual tradeoff; do not treat the score as proof of attractiveness.
4. Choose the camera rendering with `Phone-camera realism`. On (default) uses the accepted deep-focus Smartphone Snapshot v13 LoRA at `0.25` with its trained `casual snapshot` trigger and skips the background-blur stage entirely. Turn it off for optional gentle, optical-looking background separation using a local U2Net human matte and subject-excluding depth-ramped blur after generation. The phone-off path copies subject pixels back exactly, avoiding face, hair, clothing, and silhouette changes.
5. Keep seed `8675416` first. Use `8675412` only as one controlled retry.
6. Queue only on the RTX 3090 worker at port `8188`.

The node automatically supplies four locked references in this exact order:
- source photo at `1.00 MP` for scene, pose, expression, clothing, and composition
- face-interior-free Canny guide at `0.50 MP` for geometry
- protected genuine Mitch identity photo at `0.50 MP`
- protected isolated genuine hair crop at `0.10 MP`

Locked default generation settings: Base 9B `fp8_e4m3fn`, identity LoRA `0.90`, 50 Euler steps, CFG `4.0`, `Flux2Scheduler`, and one empty-latent whole-frame pass. There is no Turbo, source-latent init, generation mask, face swap, restoration, upscaling, or second model pass. With phone off, the node additionally saves the detailed pre-blur image and exact background-blur mask; handsome polish saves its raw before image and face/iris/hair mask. Always review identity, pupil direction, head direction, forehead/hairline, skin, background separation, subject edges, and realism at full size and thumbnail.

nodes.title: UPGRADE PHOTO DETAIL & REALISM — SAFE POLISH + OPTIONAL PHONE STYLE
widgets_values: For this included example, the man remains in the exact source three-quarter view and looks past the camera toward image-right. Preserve the exact raised-collar coat silhouette, shirt opening, building-wall diagonals, roof edge, bare-tree layout, and every foreground/background boundary. Render the same real house exterior with separate horizontal siding boards, narrow straight seams, subtle matte painted texture, and minor surface variation. Render the same leafless tree with tapered limbs, bark ridges, irregular forks, progressively thinner twigs, tiny buds, and distinct overlapping depth layers. Keep the whole environment legible with natural small-sensor depth of field; distant elements soften gradually but remain structurally readable instead of becoming portrait-mode bokeh.
